meta.low_paid: LODES earnings bands SE01 + SE02: $3,333 a month or less
meta.note: Primary jobs (JT01), in Colorado only, home block to work block. Distances are straight-line; roads are longer. LODES assigns some workers to an employer main office, so long distances include some people who do not make that trip daily. Places with fewer than 200 primary jobs are left out.
